scripts.text: Uh? What am I doing? I came here for an errand...
scripts.translation: 咦？我在做什么来着？我是来这里办事的...

scripts.text: ^000099Maybe my feeling has moved to another body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099也许我的意识已经转移到另一具身体里了。^000000

scripts.text: Oh you are so young. Keep working hard.
scripts.translation: 哦，你还真年轻。继续努力吧。

scripts.text: You are dragging something. If you're riding something you better dismount it before proceeding.
scripts.translation: 你还拖着什么东西。如果你骑着坐骑，最好先下来再继续。

scripts.text: I don't have anything to say to you. Find another person.
scripts.translation: 我没什么要对你说的。去找别人吧。

scripts.text: What was I saying... (mumble) the remaining segment is in Glast Heim around 13.......
scripts.translation: 我刚才说到哪儿了...（嘟囔）剩下的部分在古城，坐标大约是 13...

scripts.text: If you don't have business with me, just keep going my friend.
scripts.translation: 如果你没事找我，就继续走吧，朋友。

scripts.text: You don't look like a Knight...
You're a curious one. Who are you? What do you want?
scripts.translation: 你真是个好奇的人。你是谁？想做什么？

scripts.text: Who am I? Who are you?
Do you want to argue with me? Do you know who I am?
scripts.translation: 你想和我吵架吗？你知道我是谁吗？

scripts.text: Sorry, I won't hurt your feelings.
Sorry. I had to be sure. I didn't know that you are from the royal palace.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我必须确认一下。我不知道你是王宫的人。

scripts.text: That's enough. Don't make this mistake again.
I'm a member here and have the authority to find out what your business is here.
scripts.translation: 我是这里的成员，有权查明你来这里的目的。

scripts.text: You are a stranger and I'm not sure if you belong here.
scripts.translation: 你是个陌生人，我不确定你是否属于这里。

scripts.text: If you tell me your identity, I will apologize.
scripts.translation: 只要你告诉我身份，我就向你道歉。

scripts.text: If you really want, I will introduce myself.
scripts.translation: 你若真的想知道，我就自我介绍一下。

scripts.text: I'm collecting information about King Schmidtz's trace which has disappeared.
scripts.translation: 我正在搜集国王施密特兹失踪遗迹的相关情报。

scripts.text: Schmidzt's trace? Is it a treasure?
scripts.translation: 施密茨的踪迹？那是宝物吗？

scripts.text: Most archaeologists are eager to get treasure. I'm looking for traces of the ^000099Royal Guard^000000 and their sons who belong to the Schmidtz line.
scripts.translation: 大多数考古学家都热衷于寻宝。我寻找的是^000099皇家禁卫队^000000及其施密特兹王族后裔留下的踪迹。

scripts.text: Sounds interesting doesn't it? I can't really say but their history and files are under strict security.
scripts.translation: 听起来很有意思吧？不过我不能多说，他们的历史和档案都受到严密保护。

scripts.text: I can't really talk about the Royal Guard to just anyone who asks about them.
scripts.translation: 我不能随便向任何打听的人谈论皇家禁卫队。

scripts.text: BUT!! I want to believe you...
It's not a simple story to tell a person like you. Go back.
scripts.translation: 这可不是能随便讲给你听的故事。回去吧。

scripts.text: Just forget it and let your mind do more worthy things.
scripts.translation: 忘了这件事吧，把心思放在更有意义的事情上。

scripts.text: Do you have more things to talk to me about?
scripts.translation: 你还有别的事要和我说吗？

scripts.text: If you can't trust me, test me pal.
scripts.translation: 如果你不信任我，那就考验我一下，朋友

scripts.text: Did you say the test? Huhu!
Friend, you have shown your interest about my job, are you sure? Or are you kidding me?
scripts.translation: 朋友，你似乎对我的工作很感兴趣，确定吗？还是在开玩笑？

scripts.text: Good. You might have the wrong idea about what a Royal Guard is. So, in your opinion, what do you think is the key to being a Royal Guard?
scripts.translation: 很好。你对皇家禁卫队可能有些误解。那么依你看，成为皇家禁卫队成员的关键是什么？

scripts.text: Actually, the other 3 are also needed to have the Royal Guard spirit, friend.
scripts.translation: 其实另外三项也是皇家禁卫队精神的一部分，朋友。

scripts.text: But according to research documents about the Royal Guard, the best belief is 'asceticism and endurance'.
scripts.translation: 不过根据皇家禁卫队的研究资料，最重要的信念是“苦修与忍耐”。

scripts.text: Asceticism and Endurance young one. It is a bit different from what you answered.
scripts.translation: 是苦修与忍耐，年轻人。这和你的答案有些不同。

scripts.text: You seem to have a large interest about this story but I can't tell you more.
scripts.translation: 看来你对这段故事很感兴趣，不过我不能再告诉你更多。

scripts.text: Only those who have qualification can hear the Royal Guard history.
scripts.translation: 只有符合资格的人才能听闻皇家禁卫队的历史。

scripts.text: What can I do to hear that story?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么做才能听到那个故事？

scripts.text: ^000099Heinrich has an agonized look on his face. Then he looked like he fell asleep. Finally he says with reckless abandon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099海因里希满脸为难，接着像睡着似的沉默了片刻，最后仿佛豁出去一般开了口。^000000

scripts.text: If so I will test you to see your asceticism and endurance.
scripts.translation: 既然如此，我就测试你的苦修与忍耐。

scripts.text: Long ago King Schmidtz gave a title to a brave soldier who come back with 100 Sacred Marks.
scripts.translation: 很久以前，施密特兹国王将一个称号赐给带回100个神圣印记的勇士。

scripts.text: If you want to hear more story, you have to show me your similar attitude.
scripts.translation: 如果你想听更多故事，就得让我看到你也有这样的决心。

scripts.text: Good idea, it would better to find something more worthy.
scripts.translation: 好主意，还是去找些更有意义的事做吧。

scripts.text: Ok, let's do it this way. Actually it's too difficult to collect 100 Sacred Marks, just show your ambition by collecting 100 Burning Hearts.
scripts.translation: 好吧，就这么办。收集100个神圣印记太难了，就收集100颗燃烧的心来证明你的决心吧。

scripts.text: If you bring them I can tell you more of the story. That means you show your endurance to me.
scripts.translation: 把它们带来，我就能继续讲这个故事。这也能证明你的耐力。

scripts.text: Don't forget to bring the 100 Burning Hearts.
scripts.translation: 别忘了带来100颗燃烧的心。

scripts.text: Don't forget to bring 100 Burning Heart.
scripts.translation: 别忘了带来100颗燃烧的心。

scripts.text: Did you get all of them?
Most people just ignore me or give up the mission.
scripts.translation: 大多数人都不理我，或者半途放弃。

scripts.text: Wait while I arrange the stuff that you brought.
scripts.translation: 稍等，我整理一下你带来的东西。

scripts.text: Good. I can feel truth from your heart. Now I can tell you more of the story.
scripts.translation: 很好，我能感受到你内心的真诚。现在我可以继续讲这个故事了。

scripts.text: The best members of the Crusader and Paladin classes can gain the qualification of the Royal Guard.
scripts.translation: 十字军和圣殿十字军中最优秀的成员，才有资格成为皇家禁卫队。

scripts.text: They are agents of the divine order and judge with swift punishment.
scripts.translation: 他们是神圣秩序的执行者，以迅捷的惩罚裁决罪恶。

scripts.text: We still have many opinions about how they could have survived. Surely someone had to have believed that their history was not false.
scripts.translation: 关于他们如何存活至今，众说纷纭。但一定有人相信他们的历史并非虚构。

scripts.text: Unfortunately after King Schmidtz disappeared, traces of the Royal Guard disappeared.
scripts.translation: 遗憾的是，施密特兹国王失踪后，皇家禁卫队也销声匿迹了。

scripts.text: Their history, belief, vision and fighting skill seemingly disappeared without any of the documents being saved.
scripts.translation: 他们的历史、信念、理想和战斗技巧似乎都随之消失，没有留下任何档案。

scripts.text: It's like it disappeared with the king.
scripts.translation: 就像是和国王一起消失了。

scripts.text: So the reason of finding their traces...
scripts.translation: 所以我寻找他们的踪迹，是因为...

scripts.text: I was worried about past Royal Guards that might not have been able to pass down their history.
scripts.translation: 我担心过去的皇家禁卫队成员没能把他们的历史传承下来。

scripts.text: The mysterious power... can't appear anymore in the world. How disappointing is it~!
scripts.translation: 那种神秘力量...再也不会出现在世上了。真令人遗憾啊~！

scripts.text: That's why I'm concentrating to revive their job.
scripts.translation: 所以我正专心致力于让这个职业重现。

scripts.text: How much progress have you made?
Fortunately, I excavated most of the treasures and interpreted them. I just have one trace left to find.
scripts.translation: 幸好，大部分宝物我都已挖掘并解读完毕。现在只剩最后一条线索要找。

scripts.text: The Royal Guard carved the mark of King Schmidtz on their clothes. The trace of this custom is the last clue.
scripts.translation: 皇家禁卫队会在衣服上刻下施密特兹国王的徽记。这个习俗留下的痕迹就是最后的线索。

scripts.text: According to reports from other cities the last trace possibly exists in a monastery inside of Glass Heim.
scripts.translation: 据其他城市的报告，最后的痕迹可能在古城内部的一座修道院里。

scripts.text: But it is too dangerous for me there so I almost gave up.
scripts.translation: 那里对我来说太危险了，所以我几乎放弃了。

scripts.text: Now I can't tell you why the trace is there.
scripts.translation: 现在我还不能告诉你那条线索为何在那里。
有意思。我可以去那里吗？

scripts.text: Good idea, that's useless work to explore there.
scripts.translation: 好主意，去那里探索只是白费力气。

scripts.text: You shouldn't treat it like it's just some normal chore.
scripts.translation: 你不该把它当成普通差事。
我没开玩笑。我是认真的

scripts.text: If you say it like that I don't have any more options.
scripts.translation: 既然你这么说，我也别无选择了。

scripts.text: I don't know if it will be helpful or not. I will write an explanation in detail.
scripts.translation: 不知道这能不能帮上忙。我会把说明详细写下来。

scripts.text: ^000099Here's the last trace of the Royal Guard. Open the quest window and check the position.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这是皇家卫士留下的最后一条线索。打开任务窗口查看位置。^000000

scripts.text: Our staff has already left to find the last trace, so don't work too hard.
scripts.translation: 我们的人已经出发去寻找最后的线索了，你不用太费心。

scripts.text: No, it's not the correct one that I want.
scripts.translation: 不，这不是我要找的那个。

scripts.text: You surprised me. How did you get it? So far no one could get it.
scripts.translation: 你真让我吃惊。你是怎么找到它的？至今还没人能找到。

scripts.text: Thanks to your effort I can find the last clue. How amazing~!
scripts.translation: 多亏了你的努力，我找到了最后的线索。太不可思议了~！

scripts.text: ^000099Heinrich hesitated and brought an old shield from the side of the office.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099海因里希迟疑了一下，从办公室一旁取出一面旧盾。^000000

scripts.text: Our staff excavated it. They assumed that King Schmidtz used it. But it wasn't used by him.
scripts.translation: 我们的人挖出了它。他们以为是施密特兹国王用过的东西，但其实并非如此。

scripts.text: Sure it's wasn't used by the King?
scripts.translation: 确定不是国王用过的吗？

scripts.text: Maybe you are right but, according to when we did the initial identification we can be sure it wasn't used.
scripts.translation: 也许你说得对，不过根据最初的鉴定，我们可以确定它并未被使用过。

scripts.text: But it's an old treasure so, somehow it will be useful. I might know how to use it.
scripts.translation: 不过它是件古老的宝物，总会派上用场。我或许知道怎么使用它。

scripts.text: Someday it might be useful to you.
scripts.translation: 将来某一天它或许会对你有用。

scripts.text: ^000099You get the shield from Heinrich. There are some letters carved on the inside of the shield.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你从海因里希那里拿到了盾牌。盾牌内侧刻着一些文字。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099If you want to see the letters, please check the quest window.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099如果你想看那些文字，请查看任务窗口。^000000

scripts.text: I'll be deciphering the cloth for now so I will be very busy!
scripts.translation: 我现在要解读这块布料，会非常忙！

scripts.text: What? Did you lose the shield? What is the one on your back?
scripts.translation: 什么？你把盾牌弄丢了？那你背上的是什么？

scripts.text: Thanks to your help I can finish the excavation work. Thanks a lot.
scripts.translation: 多亏你的帮助，我才能完成挖掘工作。非常感谢。

scripts.text: Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation: 请先从坐骑上下来，再试一次！

scripts.text: ^000099You seem to have lost the shield. Go back to Heinrich and ask for help^000000.
scripts.translation: ^000099你似乎弄丢了盾牌。回到海因里希那里寻求帮助^000000。

scripts.text: Too bad. Here is one more friend who has been cheated by Heinrich.
scripts.translation: 真遗憾，又有一位朋友被海因里希骗了。

scripts.text: He was my faithful adjutant. And he has continued to be so for hundreds of years.
scripts.translation: 他曾是我忠诚的副官。数百年来，他始终如此。

scripts.text: How has he lived for hundreds...
Maybe his body is just a cast. He found a way to move from body to body in order to stay alive.
scripts.translation: 也许他的身体只是个躯壳。他找到了在不同躯体间转移、以此延续生命的方法。

scripts.text: He doesn't want to accept my death and wanders the world, continuing to find Royal Guards.
scripts.translation: 他不愿接受我的死讯，便一直在世间徘徊，继续寻找皇家禁卫队成员。

scripts.text: What's the meaning of this shield?
The shield from Heinrich is our contract before I died.
scripts.translation: 海因里希给你的盾牌，是我死前与他约定的契约。

scripts.text: Heinrich was charged with finding the proper people to become Royal Guards, the shield was to be the contract.
scripts.translation: 海因里希受命寻找合适的人选，让他们成为皇家禁卫队成员；那面盾牌就是契约的凭证。

scripts.text: To him, this was the last order that I gave to him.
scripts.translation: 对他而言，这是我留给他的最后一道命令。

scripts.text: Now he doesn't need to do it anymore, but will remain as a fool whom can't forget his King's final order.
scripts.translation: 如今他已经不必再这么做，却仍像个傻瓜一样，无法忘记国王的最后一道命令。

scripts.text: So what now? Can I leave?
scripts.translation: 那现在怎么办？我可以走了吗？

scripts.text: Sorry but I can't send you now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在还不能送你离开。

scripts.text: This is a contract with Heinrich so I have to keep it. You look faithful and brave.
scripts.translation: 这是我与海因里希的契约，所以我必须遵守。你看起来忠诚又勇敢。

scripts.text: Now, it's time to keep the promise with Heinrich. It's up to you.
scripts.translation: 现在该履行与海因里希的约定了。决定权在你。

scripts.text: I'm planning to accept you as a member of the Royal Guard to continue their lost traditions. Are you ready to do it?
scripts.translation: 我打算接纳你成为皇家禁卫队的一员，延续他们失传的传统。你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Umm, maybe Heinrich had wrong judgement.
scripts.translation: 嗯，也许海因里希判断错了。

scripts.text: If so, I will proceed to making you a Royal Guard.
scripts.translation: 既然如此，我就让你成为皇家禁卫队的一员。

scripts.text: Perhaps Heinrich had the wrong image of you.
scripts.translation: 也许海因里希看错你了。

scripts.text: Look at your body before that!
scripts.translation: 先看看你自己的身体吧！

scripts.text: Are still sentimentally attached to yourself?
scripts.translation: 你还留恋着现在的自己吗？

scripts.text: You cannot inherit the Royal Guard!
scripts.translation: 你无法继承皇家禁卫队的传统！
恭喜你，年轻的皇家禁卫队成员。

scripts.text: Be a symbol of honor and continue the great tradition of your new name.
scripts.translation: 愿你成为荣誉的象征，以新的身份延续伟大的传统。

scripts.text: While investigating, the topography breaks. It would be better to dig other places for a while.
scripts.translation: 挖掘时，地面塌陷了，暂时去别处找找吧。

scripts.text: There is a trace that someone has already dug here.
scripts.translation: 这里有被人挖过的痕迹。

scripts.text: I can feel strong power around here. It would be better to explore around here.
scripts.translation: 能感觉到附近有强大的力量，再往周围找找吧。

scripts.text: Set item to adjust the Royal Guard
scripts.translation: 选择要调整的皇家禁卫队物品

scripts.text: You can only set a number between 1 to 5.
scripts.translation: 只能设置1到5之间的数值。

scripts.text: Set item to adjust the Rune Knight
scripts.translation: 选择要调整的符文骑士物品

scripts.text: You can only set a nbumber between 1 to 24.
scripts.translation: 只能设置1到24之间的数值。

scripts.text: Set item to adjust the Sorcerer
scripts.translation: 选择要调整的咒术师物品

scripts.text: You can only set a number between 1 to 5.
scripts.translation: 只能设置1到5之间的数值。
